collection_name: AndhraBharati — classical Telugu literature e-texts
organization: AndhraBharati (volunteer project)
description: Large curated site of Unicode Telugu texts organised by genre — itihasas, kavyas, satakas, kavitalu, keertanas (Annamayya, Tyagaraja), natakas, folk (desi), women/children's literature, history and grammar — plus a dictionary search (TEL-LEX-001).
genres: itihasa; kavya; sataka; keertana; nataka; folk songs; vachana; grammar; history
size_telugu: Unknown (dozens of genre indexes; not counted)
acquisition_method: Read online; any crawling requires permission (site states all rights reserved).
license: All rights reserved (site footer)
copyright_notes: Underlying classical texts are PD, but the edited e-texts and apparatus are claimed by the site; ask permission before bulk use.
verification_method: Home and kAvyamulu index pages fetched (HTTP 200); works not counted
unresolved_issues: Count works per genre; ask maintainers about research licensing.
processing_needs: High-quality, proofread classical text — ideal for a classical-Telugu subcorpus if permission is obtained.

collection_name: Epigraphy volumes — South Indian Inscriptions, Epigraphia Indica, Epigraphia Andhrica
organization: Archaeological Survey of India (publications); AP Dept of Archaeology & Museums (Epigraphia Andhrica); scanned copies on IA
description: Published editions of Telugu (and Sanskrit/Kannada/Tamil) inscriptions with transliteration and translation — key source for Old Telugu (6th c. onwards) and Kakatiya/Vijayanagara-era texts.
size_telugu: IA title matches: South Indian Inscriptions 210, Epigraphia Indica 342, Epigraphia Andhrica 4, other AP/Telangana inscription volumes 31
acquisition_method: ia search 'title:("south indian inscriptions")' --itemlist; ia download
license: Mostly no licence field; Government publications, older volumes PD
verification_method: IA title-search counts (not all volumes contain Telugu inscriptions)
unresolved_issues: Identify which volumes contain Telugu inscriptions (e.g. SII vols. IV, V, VI, X, XVI).
processing_needs: Mixed-script OCR (Telugu inscription text, Roman transliteration, English).

collection_name: AndhraBharati nighantu sodhana — 51 searchable Telugu dictionaries
organization: AndhraBharati (volunteer project)
description: Unified search over 51 digitised dictionaries: 11 Telugu-Telugu (Sabdaratnakaramu 1912, Andhra Vachaspatyamu, Suryaraya-era works, Telugu Vyutpatti Kosam 1978, G.N. Reddy 1979...), Brown Telugu-English 1903 and English-Telugu 1852, Sankaranarayana, 5 Sanskrit-Telugu, 4 Urdu-Telugu, 10 dialect dictionaries (Telangana, Kalinga, Srikakulam, Nalgonda, Visakha, agricultural occupational terms), names, nyaya, and 9 technical/specialised (legal, journalism, fine arts) dictionaries. 94 dictionaries are planned.
languages: te; en; sa; ur; ta; kn
acquisition_method: Search interface only; permissions credited to authors' families/publishers — bulk use requires agreement with AndhraBharati and rights holders.
license: All rights reserved (site footer); several dictionaries used with permission of copyright holders
copyright_notes: Pre-1965 dictionaries (e.g. Brown 1852/1903, Sabdaratnakaramu 1912) are PD in their original form; the site's digitised versions and post-1965 works are not.
verification_method: Dictionary selection list read (51 entries, authors, years), footer and credits read
processing_needs: Best single Telugu lexical resource; dialect dictionaries are unique for dialect work.

collection_name: Telugu Wikipedia XML dumps (tewiki)
organization: Wikimedia Foundation / Telugu Wikipedia community
description: Full-text dumps of Telugu Wikipedia (articles, talk, templates; also SQL link tables and Cirrus JSON). Site statistics on 2026-11-09 report 130,627 content articles and 432,091 pages in total.
genres: encyclopedic; biography; geography; cinema; history; science
metadata_fields: page id; title; revision id; timestamp; contributor; categories
annotations: wiki markup; categories; interlanguage links; Wikidata QIDs
acquisition_method: wget https://dumps.wikimedia.org/tewiki/latest/tewiki-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2 ; extract with WikiExtractor or mwparserfromhell. Twice-monthly dumps.
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text; also GFDL for older revisions); media files carry individual licenses
copyright_notes: Share-alike and attribution required; images/media are licensed per file on Commons and are not covered by the text license.

verification_method: MediaWiki siteinfo API (statistics, rightsinfo) + dump directory listing
processing_needs: Wiki-markup stripping; filter bot-generated stubs (village articles); dedup against web crawls that already include Wikipedia.
